subject.title: fix(heartbeat): keep private final reply off-channel in message_tool mode

question: After refreshing this branch onto current main, does the explicit `message_tool` contract intentionally require silent handling of every unmarked no-tool heartbeat final while preserving only marked notices and relayable exec completions?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but the final authority for intentionally suppressing fallback heartbeat output across channel targets belongs to the current heartbeat delivery-policy owners.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase onto current main, rerun the focused heartbeat suites, confirm the two exception classes, and merge the privacy fix.
